desc: Designed to work with a variety of weapon systems the Citadel QD M-lok rail mount makes adding a sling a breeze. Specifically made to work with the push button Quick Disconnect swivel system, allowing users to remove the sling quickly and easily from their weapon. Compatible with M-Lok handrails you can easily modify it to fit your personal taste. So keep your firearm close with the allen tac- Six Citadel QD Mount.
